I have been farming these same 5 mu in Quzhou for 60 years. I only finished primary school, but I can read the numbers on the fertilizer bags, and I know what works on my land. My father taught me, and now I just copy what I did last year, because at 83 years old, change is risky. Old Wang next door plants the same way, and his yields are always fine.

For wheat: I sow in October, right after the maize comes off. First I plough the field deep with the small tractor. Then I spread one full bag of compound fertilizer per mu — 50 kg, the kind that says 15-15-15 on the bag. I sow improved wheat seed, the same kind I bought last year from the supply store. In March, when the wheat turns green after winter, I spread half a bag of urea per mu, 25 kg. That is my nitrogen. I irrigate three times from my well: once after sowing if the soil is dry, once at jointing, and once when the grain is filling. I spray pesticides twice — once for weeds right after sowing, and once later if I see aphids or rust. I expect about 450 kg per mu if the weather is normal. Last year I got about that.

For maize: In June, right after cutting the wheat, I rotary-till fast and plant hybrid corn seed the same day. You cannot waste time in summer. I put down 40 kg of compound fertilizer per mu at sowing. When the corn reaches the big trumpet stage, I top-dress with 25 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate twice from the well: the first time when it gets dry in mid-summer, and the second time at silking — that one you cannot skip, or the ears will be half-empty. I spray twice: once for weeds, once for corn borer. I expect 550 kg per mu.

I know fertilizer is expensive now — one bag of urea costs over 100 yuan. But on 5 mu, I need about two and a half bags of urea and four and a half bags of compound for the whole year. That is around 700 to 800 yuan for fertilizer. I would rather spend that than risk losing 200 kg per mu. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is just a cost. With only two of us in the house, we do the work ourselves, so we do not hire labor. We can handle 5 mu, but every yuan counts.
